items.title: TU Delft Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
items.get: Full first-year tuition plus a living-cost contribution for a Master's at TU Delft, Netherlands.
items.who: Top non-EU applicants to an eligible TU Delft MSc.
steps: Pick an eligible TU Delft MSc programme
Submit your MSc application before 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Complete the scholarship section with your motivation
Keep transcripts and CV ready for selection
items.flag: Date from a scholarship tracker that checked official pages; confirm on TU Delft's site.

items.title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
items.get: €10,000 to €19,000 off tuition for a Leiden Master's.
items.who: Excellent non-EU Master's applicants.
steps: Choose a Leiden Master's
Apply for the programme before 1 Dec 2026
Tick the LExS option in your application
Upload your strongest transcript and motivation
items.flag: Confirm the date on Leiden's scholarship page.

items.title: Clarendon Scholarship, University of Oxford
items.get: Full course fees plus a living grant at Oxford. Around 140 new awards a year.
items.who: All graduate applicants to degree-bearing courses. No separate form.
steps: Find your course's December or January deadline on its Oxford page
Apply to the course by that deadline, 12:00 noon UK
References must arrive by the same deadline
You are considered automatically

items.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
items.get: Full-cost Master's or PhD funding at the University of Cambridge.
items.who: Citizens of any country outside the UK; non-US applicants use the international round.
steps: Choose an eligible Cambridge course
Check whether its funding deadline is 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027
Complete the Gates section inside the Cambridge application
Arrange the extra Gates reference

items.title: WAAW Foundation STEM Scholarship for African women
items.get: A one-time US$500 award, plus a STEM community and outreach work.
items.who: Female undergraduates of African origin studying STEM in Africa. Medicine and nursing are excluded; pharmacy is in.
steps: Confirm you're enrolled in a STEM bachelor's in Africa
Get a signed copy of your current transcript
Write about your need and your plans
Apply on the official WAAW page
items.flag: Closing date reported by a listings site; confirm on WAAW's page.

items.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
items.get: EU-funded Master's across several European universities. Top applicants get full scholarships.
items.who: Students worldwide.
steps: Browse the official Erasmus Mundus catalogue
Pick up to three programmes that fit your degree
Note each programme's own scholarship deadline
Apply on each programme's website

items.title: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (University of Amsterdam)
items.get: Faculty awards for a UvA Master's, e.g. €26,125 in the Faculty of Science.
items.who: Outstanding non-EU/EEA students, typically top 10% of their class.
steps: Choose a UvA Master's
Apply before 15 Jan 2027
Say yes to UvA scholarship consideration on the form
Check your faculty page for amount and extras

items.title: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals
items.dueText: University by 15 Jan 2027 · SI form 8–24 Feb 2027
items.get: Full tuition, SEK 12,000 a month, travel grant and insurance for a Swedish Master's.
items.who: Citizens of 34 countries including Nigeria, Kenya and South Africa (Ghana isn't on the list). Needs work and leadership experience.
steps: Apply to eligible Swedish Master's on University Admissions by 15 Jan 2027
Gather proof of work and leadership experience
Submit the SI scholarship form between 8 and 24 Feb 2027
Results on 22 Apr 2027

items.title: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary)
items.get: Free tuition, monthly stipend, housing support and health insurance in Hungary. Bachelor's to PhD.
items.who: Citizens of about 80 partner countries.
steps: Check your country is a partner on the official site
Pick up to two programmes
Apply on the official portal
Your home country's partner body nominates you
items.flag: Expected date based on last year's cycle. Confirm the portal is open.

items.title: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
items.get: €5,000 for your first year of a Bachelor's or Master's in the Netherlands.
items.who: Non-EEA students with no previous Dutch degree.
steps: See the 2027–28 list of participating universities
Apply for your programme
Apply for the NL Scholarship at that university
Meet that university's own deadline

items.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
items.get: Tuition, housing, monthly stipend and insurance in China. Bachelor's to PhD.
items.who: Non-Chinese citizens. Apply through your embassy or straight to a university.
steps: Choose your route: embassy (Type A) or university (Type B)
Find that route's deadline
Apply on the Campus China system
Send documents the route asks for
items.flag: Deadlines differ by route; check yours.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
items.get: Full scholarships with laptop, travel, mentorship and leadership training.
items.who: Young Africans with strong grades and financial need.
steps: Pick a partner university still open
Apply for admission first
Complete the Scholars Program form
Show need and community impact
items.flag: Many partner universities have closed for 2027; check each one.

items.title: Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship Programme
items.get: US$5,000 non-refundable seed capital, training and mentorship.
items.who: Entrepreneurs in all 54 African countries.
steps: Write a one-page plan now: problem, customer, money
Create a TEFConnect account when applications open
Apply early; the 2026 round closed on 1 Mar
Finish the training if selected
items.flag: Opening date expected from past cycles.

items.title: CrowdGen by Appen: AI training tasks
items.get: Paid project work for AI teams: rating, recording, transcribing. Paid monthly by PayPal, Payoneer and others.
items.who: Contributors in 200 countries. Projects set their own location rules.
steps: Apply to a project opening on crowdgen.com
Set up your profile and payment method
Pass the project qualification
Never pay anyone to join; CrowdGen charges no fee

items.title: Mindrift: AI tutoring and evaluation
items.get: Paid tasks writing and checking AI answers. Toloka's older tasks moved here.
items.who: Open widely, including Nigeria. Higher tiers need subject expertise.
steps: Sign up on the official site
Pick your field
Pass the qualification test
Withdraw to a supported method

items.title: Mercor: expert AI work
items.get: Contract roles for professionals, paid weekly through Stripe to your bank.
items.who: Nigeria is a supported payment country; each listing sets its own countries.
steps: Create a profile and upload your CV
Apply to a listing that matches your field
Do the AI interview
Real emails end in @mercor.com

items.title: Harvard CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
items.get: Harvard's famous course, free online, with a free certificate when you finish.
items.who: Anyone, any background.
steps: Open the course page
Watch week 0
Submit each problem set
Claim your free certificate

items.title: freeCodeCamp certifications
items.get: Free web development, data and Python certifications.
items.who: Anyone with a browser.
steps: Make a free account
Start Responsive Web Design
Build the required projects
Claim each certification

items.title: ALX All Access Lite
items.get: Free AI Starter Kit. Full programmes cost US$5 a month on All Access.

Choose All Access Lite (free)
Finish the AI Starter Kit
Upgrade only if you want more

Click Financial aid available
Answer the questions honestly
Start the course while you wait
